meta.name: ai-amazon-subscribe-save
meta.description: Amazon 订阅优化助手适合运营、产品、销售、software在用户提出“订阅省能留住人吗”这类问题，需要快速拆解目标、判断重点并形成可执行结果时使用，帮助基于输入材料生成商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。

copy.tagline: 分析订阅省方案，生成商品诊断与运营建议
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果负责亚马逊店铺运营，需要快速评估订阅省策略效果。
copy.tagline_en: Analyze Subscribe & Save plans to generate product diagnostics and action suggestions
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage Amazon store operations and need quick evaluation of Subscribe & Save strategies.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 能根据你提供的商品信息、运营目标等材料，生成商品/店铺诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。
howto.when: 当你提出“订阅省能留住人吗”这类问题，或需要围绕 Amazon 订阅优化生成诊断和建议时触发。

say.text: 帮我分析这个商品的订阅省功能，给出诊断和优化建议。
say.note: 会输出商品诊断、卖点与风险提示、运营动作建议。

say.text: 针对我的店铺，生成订阅省优化方案，包括风险提示。
say.note: 会结合店铺信息输出诊断和建议。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can generate product/store diagnosis, selling points and risk tips, and operational action suggestions based on your input materials such as product info and business goals.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask questions like 'Can Subscribe & Save retain customers?' or need diagnosis and suggestions around Amazon Subscribe & Save optimization.

say_en.text: Analyze this product's Subscribe & Save feature and give diagnosis and optimization suggestions.
say_en.note: Outputs product diagnosis, selling points, risk tips, and action suggestions.

say_en.text: Generate a Subscribe & Save optimization plan for my store, including risk tips.
say_en.note: Outputs diagnosis and suggestions based on store info.
